title: Challenges of DMEK Technique with Young Corneal Donors’ Grafts: Surgical Keys for Success—A Pilot Study
indication: Fuchs endothelial corneal dystrophy without haze or posterior stromal fibrosis; DMEK as a single procedure (modified SCUBA, double-roll graft, SF6 20%) with very young donors (20-30 years, Eusol-C at 4 °C for 3-4 days); one eye had DMEK three months after a failed Descemetorhexis stripping only (DSO); one surgeon
